subject.title: fix(whatsapp): normalize hosted JIDs consistently with Baileys

question: Should OpenClaw adopt this permanent fail-closed upgrade policy for existing WhatsApp LID-form allowlists, where only uniquely verified mappings are converted and unresolved entries require operator repair?
rationale: This is an authorization and compatibility policy choice, not a mechanical correction: it can intentionally revoke an existing allowlist entry until a verified E.164 mapping is available.

options.title: Approve guarded migration
options.body: Accept the fail-closed policy after an owner confirms the Doctor warnings and operator-repair path are the intended upgrade contract.

options.title: Preserve legacy authorization temporarily
options.body: Retain legacy LID allowlist behavior behind a documented transitional path if preventing upgrade-time authorization loss outweighs the stricter canonical policy.

options.title: Narrow the PR
options.body: Land only JID normalization that does not change stored allowlist migration, then handle authorization migration in a separately approved proposal.

recommendation.title: Approve guarded migration
recommendation.body: Accept the fail-closed policy after an owner confirms the Doctor warnings and operator-repair path are the intended upgrade contract.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the current contributor across the affected WhatsApp JID and migration implementation and can clarify the intended operational contract.
